svg.font-family: 'Source Sans Pro', 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
svg.aria-label: The three runs of the L21 Lab. Run 1, Steps 7 to 9: the HB100 fixed while the kit steps the beam, a broadside beam-sweep trace against steer angle. Run 2, Steps 10 to 15: the beam held at 0 degrees while you carry the HB100 along the arc, the same pattern against elapsed time. Run 3, Steps 16 to 20: the HB100 fixed and the kit turned on its stand, the 0 and 30 degree beams read at the stand's 10 degree marks. Each thumbnail is in dBc at 10.3 GHz, clipped at the noise floor.
